name: Ferrogate Transit Security Bike
description: A light electric motorcycle used by Ferrogate transit security for patrol and rapid response along rail lines, bus routes, and transit hubs. Faster than walking, smaller than a cruiser, and cheap enough to deploy in numbers. T-Bike riders are the most visible law enforcement presence in Tier 1-2 transit areas — for better or worse. Most are just trying to keep the L-train platforms safe. Some are on the take. The bike itself is unremarkable, functional, and bearing the Ferrogate blue-and-gray livery that everyone in Meridian 88 recognizes.
armament: Siren, lights, integrated comm system, stun baton mount.
common_usage: Transit line patrol, platform security, emergency response along routes.
story_hooks: A T-Bike officer discovers that their dispatch system has been routing them to avoid a specific platform at specific times — clearing it for something
Off-duty T-Bike officers moonlight as couriers using their security clearance to bypass checkpoints
